Hymn 291: Turn Your Hearts
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Terry Hatch
Lyricist/Text Author: Paul L. Anderson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 291 titled "Turn Your Hearts" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Terry Hatch and the lyrics were written by Paul L. Anderson.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
